claim: The one-click demo uses sample data and never reads or writes the real board.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create real data, enter /demo, mutate and reset it, then return and assert real data remains

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; install worker, go offline, reload, and assert sample data plus offline state

claim: The free planner needs no account, stores the schedule on-device, and sends no schedule, analytics, or tracking request away.
where: first screen, about dialog, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context with full request capture; add and reload a plan; assert persistence, no account UI, and zero cross-origin requests

claim: Adding plans, printing, calendar export, and a password-protected copy are free.
where: first screen, supporter section, supporter dialog, terms
sandbox: fresh unlicensed board; add a plan, invoke print, and download a calendar file and encrypted copy

claim: Exports tested daily and weekly repeats as UTC calendar times.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; download a calendar file and assert VCALENDAR, UTC DTSTART, daily and weekly RRULE, and four sample VEVENTs

claim: Imports a standard calendar file into the board.
sandbox: fresh /demo context at a fixed date; upload a standard calendar-file fixture and assert its plan and import result

claim: Creates an AES-GCM encrypted file and QR board snapshot in the browser; opening it replaces the named board after confirmation.
where: handoff dialog, privacy page, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; observe AES-GCM use, assert ciphertext excludes names, render QR, mutate board, confirm named restore, and assert the snapshot replaced the mutation

claim: Supports all-day plans and daily, weekly, and monthly repeats.
sandbox: fresh fixed-date /demo context; create each plan type and assert visible all-day, daily, next-week, and next-month occurrences

claim: File and QR copies do not sync after they are opened.
where: limits section, sharing dialog, terms, README
sandbox: two fresh browser contexts; open an encrypted copy on the receiver, change the sender, reload the receiver, and assert the receiver remains unchanged

claim: Shows each person's name and colour on their plans.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert sample plans expose names and at least three distinct lane colours

claim: Shows a seven-day board on desktop and a one-day agenda at 390px.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; resize from 1440px to 390px and assert seven then one visible day with no overflow

claim: Prints the weekly board with all seven days.
where: board toolbar, how it works, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert Print invokes the browser and print media lays out seven days while hiding site chrome

claim: Provides system, light, and dark themes and remembers the choice.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; cycle all three theme states and assert the dark choice persists across reload
production preview; validate standalone manifest icons and assert a controlling service worker

claim: Weekboard displays the supporter pack as a ₹499 one-time purchase and starts a hosted Sociobot checkout.
where: supporter section, supporter dialog, terms, README
sandbox: fresh context; assert ₹499 and one-time copy, then inspect the hosted checkout session for INR 499, non-recurring billing, and a hosted destination

claim: A valid supporter license can be restored on another device.
sandbox: fresh context; simulate hosted return with a valid verifier response and assert supporter state

claim: The supporter pack adds a custom board name, extra colours, and more than four people.
where: supporter section, supporter dialog, terms, README
sandbox: fresh real-board context with a fixture-valid license; save a custom name, choose a fifth colour, and add a fifth person

claim: A revoked supporter license stops unlocking paid extras without affecting the free board.
sandbox: fresh context with an expired cached-valid verdict; return a revoked verifier response and assert paid settings lock
